tools.name: wait_for_event
tools.description: Wait for the next event in an inbox after a cursor, up to 30s. Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events in an inbox. Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id. Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header.

tools.name: extract_field
tools.description: Pull a JSON path out of an event body. Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header.

tools.name: delete_inbox
tools.description: Delete an inbox and its events. Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header. Irreversible: under a PAP session this needs a user approval first (Operations v3) - the first call returns the operation to approve; retry with the approval in _meta[personalagentprotocol.org/approval].

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Get one inbox: its slug, ingest URL, plan, status, and event count. Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header.

tools.name: list_inboxes
tools.description: List the inboxes linked to your AHOOK account. Auth: Authorization Bearer account key header.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete one event from an inbox (per-event purge). Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header. Archived (cold-storage) events cannot be purged this way.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the public API index (AHOOK Search, 14,000+ callable APIs and MCP servers). tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: File feedback for the AHOOK team as a support ticket: a feature request, a bug, something confusing, or anything else. A human reviews every filing; nothing is auto-built from it. Limited to 6 filings per day. Returns the ticket id and a public status URL.

tools.name: api_describe
tools.description: Describe one domain of the AHOOK API: returns the compact OpenAPI slice (operations + the schemas they reference) for that domain, so you can discover what the API can do without loading the whole spec. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "api_plan" is 865 chars, far longer than this server's median (153). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_inbox, wait_for_event, list_events, delete_inbox, get_inbox, delete_event, search, api_plan · Private data: create_inbox, wait_for_event, list_events, get_event, extract_field, delete_inbox, get_inbox, delete_event, submit_feedback · Public sink: create_inbox, search, submit_feedback, api_plan · Destructive: delete_inbox, delete_event, api_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_inbox, wait_for_event, list_events, delete_inbox, get_inbox, delete_event, search, api_plan · Private data: create_inbox, wait_for_event, list_events, get_event, extract_field, delete_inbox, get_inbox, delete_event, submit_feedback · Public sink: create_inbox, search, submit_feedback, api_plan · Destructive: delete_inbox, delete_event, api_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
